page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Right margin: one section letter "I." beside the paragraph "Tertio die resurrexit". No other margin text. Running head at top; page number 321 at top right. Catchword "corpus" at lower right; gathering signature "X j." at lower left.

main_text.p: Transitio per ἀποσιώπησιν[?]. Itaque te omissa pro-lixiore excusatione ad rem ipsam transiturum, atque dicturum de gloriosa servatoris nostri re-surrectione ex mortuis:
Adde votum: Invoco te fili Dei mortue pro nobis ac resuscitate,ut spiritu tuo mentes nostras illumines,&c.
Propositio 1. Repetam praecipuas quasdam hi-storiae partes ad fidei confirmationem.
II. Qui sint fructus resurrectionis Domini ad consolationem.
III. Ad quos hi fructus pertineant ad com-monefactionem nostram.
main_text.head: I. De resurrectionis historia.
main_text.p: Historia petenda ex Evangelistis, quorum ordinem sequar. circumstantiae praecipue tres: Tempus, modus, putefactio:
I. Tertio die resurrexit Ioh. 20. primo die he-bdomadis.I.
Ostende triduum: sexto die, qui erat parasceve Judaeorum exspiraverat. Ἐπίδειξις[?]. Verus ergo Messias.
Ratio: Quia ipse solus & nullus alius resurrexit tertio die secundum Scripturas, 1. Cor. 15.4. Matt.17.23.juxta typum Jonae. Matt.12.40.
Amplifica ab effectu hujus circumstantiae: quod inde primum diem hebdomadis Christiani sacrum celebremus.
1. Resurrexit vere a mortuis, h.e:anima vere ad corpus

page.notes: Greek word after "Transitio per" is uncertain (read as aposiopesis). Greek word after "Ostende triduum" is uncertain and only a best guess. Right margin "I." is a section letter. The printed mark before "Adde votum" and "Amplifica" is a printed symbol, not transcribed. Catchword and signature are at the foot, outside the text.
